SELECT COMPANY_ID, BRANCH_ID, SANGSA_ID, SANGSA_NM, BIZ_NO, POST_NO, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DT, TEL_NO, MPHONE_NO, NEWCAR_YN, MORTREG_YN, MORTERS_YN, TRNSNAME_YN, PAYMENT_ME, USE_YN, INS_USER, TO_CHAR(INS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS INS_DATE, UPD_USER, TO_CHAR(UPD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPD_DATE, REG_GB, REG_NO FROM TM_SANGSA WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID} AND NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
AND BRANCH_ID = #{BRANCH_ID}
AND ( TO_CHAR(SANGSA_ID) LIKE '%' || #{KEYWORD} || '%' OR SANGSA_NM LIKE '%' || #{KEYWORD} || '%' )
AND ( TO_CHAR(SANGSA_ID) LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_KEYWORD} || '%' OR SANGSA_NM LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_KEYWORD} || '%' )
ORDER BY BRANCH_ID, CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TO_CHAR(SANGSA_ID), '^[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(SANGSA_ID) ELSE 999999 END, TO_CHAR(SANGSA_ID)
